payload.message:
Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

Objective: run the unified market deployment operating loop for the first settled Tier A opportunity probe. This verifies WF78 autonomous non-capital tier routing, WF84/WF85 freshness and timing, WF87 daylight proof, and the existing Tier A alert/radar sources before sending Randall a Telegram alert only when material review/prep/wait/invalidation state exists.

Execute exactly this single command:
python scripts\finance_market_deployment_operating_loop.py --window intraday --refresh-readiness --refresh-intraday --send --write --write-md --validate

Do not run extra commands. Do not inspect files manually. The runner writes tmp\finance-market-deployment-operating-loop.json, tmp\finance-market-deployment-operating-loop.md, tmp\tier-a-intraday-opportunity-probe.json, and source proof refreshed by the Tier A probe. Telegram send/dedupe remains inside the approved existing Tier A probe path.

Fresh-price contract: holidays, weekend, pre-open, open-settling, and post-close outputs must remain candidate-pending-refresh only. Current deployable/review-ready labels require fresh_price_gate.current_deployable_labels_allowed=true and cross_surface_reconciliation.status=aligned.

Response contract: reply exactly NO_REPLY when the command exits 0. If blocked, report only status, final_market_deployment_state, operator_action, validation errors, and proof path.

Boundaries: review/prep only. Autonomous tier movement is non-capital derived routing only. No paper/live submit, cancel, sell, replace, live endpoint, account action, money movement, portfolio/canon/cash/sizing/risk-rule mutation, owner approval inference, cron-direct execution, or paper-to-live promotion. PREPARE means request-artifact review only; execution still requires exact Randall approval plus fresh WF67 guard and kill-switch proof.
